hypotheses.justification: Recover it locally using `Module.Finite.right ℚ_[p] K L` from `[Module.Finite ℚ_[p] L]` and the scalar tower, then use the original proof. Neither the conclusion nor another binder requires this instance. The lemma applies without additional nonemptiness assumptions.

The algebra map ℚ_[p] →+* L is injective because its source is a field and L is nontrivial. Mathlib supplies `CharZero ℚ_[p]`, so `charZero_of_injective_algebraMap` recovers `CharZero L` locally, after which the original proof applies. The statement does not require this instance; trivial-field cases are excluded by `[Field L]`.

Similarly, the injective algebra map ℚ_[p] →+* K and `charZero_of_injective_algebraMap` recover `CharZero K` locally. Then the original proof applies unchanged. No remaining binder or conclusion depends on this instance, and `[Field K]` excludes the trivial case. Both characteristic-zero hypotheses can also be deleted together.
